messages:
maria: Quick sync — want to schedule an inference perf + optimization review next week. Goal: share the benchmark readout, walk the latency/cost dashboards, and agree on a short action plan for batching/quantization rollouts. Proposed slots: Wed 10/15 9:00am PT or Thu 10/16 1:00pm PT. Pinged folks who should be on this: @chris @sam @anya @liam @julie-pm.
chris: Either slot works for me. Will need ~15m to present the Llama-2-13B numbers.
sam: Thu 1pm PT preferred. Can collect end-to-end cost numbers for the readout.
anya: Wed morning is tough. Thu 1pm OK. Can you add an agenda item for canary/rollback policy?
liam: Thu 1pm +1. I can bring kernel selection / quantization notes.
julie-pm: Thu is better for PM syncs too — want to see the dashboards and the suggested UX for fallback messaging.
maria: Agenda draft: 1) benchmark readout (chris) — perf tables & p50/p95 across fp16 vs int8/q4 2) latency/cost dashboard walkthrough (sam) 3) batching & KV cache policy proposals (liam) 4) canary/rollback plan + RFC pointers (anya) 5) action items & owners. Call length: 45min.
chris: Quick preview of readout I'll present:
```
model: llm-13b (baseline fp16)
load dist: 2x steady traffic
p50: 45ms
p95: 120ms
cost_per_tok: $0.0023
---
int8-q4 (quantized)
p50: 38ms
p95: 98ms
cost_per_tok: $0.0011
notes: kv-cache hit rate matters, batching improves p95 under bursty tails
```
sam: Added the dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/inference-latency (please don't share externally). I'll export the cost breakdowns per route and attach before the call.
anya: Can we add a quick triage of the recent latency spike last Friday? 20m of p95 jumps on prod. Maybe add 10min for that under item 2.
maria: Yes — slot 2 (dashboard) will include the spike triage + tracing links. @deploy-bot can you post the deploy history for Friday 23:00 UTC?
deploy-bot: deploy history for 2025-10-10 22:30-23:30 UTC: 3 completed deploys (runtime v2.14.1, model-pack-20251010). No failed deploys.
chris: For the readout, I'll include per-sequence-length breakdowns and the knob values we used (batch_size, kv cache TTL). Estimated ops to validate quantized rollout: ~2 days infra tests + canary on Dedicated (1k qps).
liam: I have a short patch to kernel scheduling that'll drop p95 by ~6-8% in our bench; will demo perf delta if time permits.
sam: Confirmed for Thu 10/16 1:00pm PT. Who will own scheduling the calendar invite?
maria: I'll schedule and add recordings + the benchmark spreadsheet. Any other asks?
julie-pm: Can you add product questions to the agenda: acceptable latency SLOs for search vs chat routes? I'll prep those.
maria: Cool — booking invite now for Thu 2025-10-16 13:00 PT, 45m. Presenters: chris (bench), sam (dashboards/cost), liam (runtime tweaks), anya (canary/rollback). I'll share materials 24h prior. If you can't make it, drop quick notes in this thread. :thumbsup:
